notes: Fenrir Link on any iPhone: point the Camera at your code, then Share and Add to Home Screen. It opens like an app, with no App Store and no computer.
The address a Fenrir Link code opens now shows Fenrir Link's own screens in any phone's browser, for hosts and friends alike, kept up to date by Fenrir.
Chrome on Android offers Install app on the same page; the Android app is still a direct download.
The page is locked down like the phone remote and answers only over a secure address.
